meta.note: None of these are implemented. Each is scoped to be independently approvable.

suggestions.title: Get the Venetian entry rule in writing for the specific event numbers
suggestions.detail: One email or phone call to the poker room, recorded with the reply date, converts 83 unverified rows into a real single-entry list — or into a confirmed re-entry list. It is the single highest-leverage action in the entire project.
suggestions.impact: Decides whether a single-entry shortlist exists at all.
suggestions.effort: One phone call + one data-file edit + rebuild (30 min).

suggestions.title: Read the Wynn WPT per-event structure sheets to fill 134 missing fees
suggestions.detail: Every WPT row currently shows a buy-in with no house fee. The poster explicitly defers fees to those sheets, so they are the authoritative next document.
suggestions.impact: Turns a buy-in into a true cost and makes WPT comparable with the Venetian.
suggestions.effort: 14–20 PDF reads + a data update (2–3 h).

suggestions.title: Capture one real date-specific checkout total per property
suggestions.detail: Pick representative dates (e.g. a Tue–Sun in December), open each booking page, and record room, fee, tax and total with a timestamp. This replaces every 'floor' figure with an actual observation.
suggestions.impact: Makes the trip total real instead of a lower bound.
suggestions.effort: 4 booking flows, screenshots, one data update (1 h).

suggestions.title: Add the remaining Strip rooms with daily tournaments
suggestions.detail: MGM Grand, ARIA, Horseshoe, Harrah's, Planet Hollywood, Flamingo, The Linq, Mandalay Bay and others run dailies. Several are cheaper than anything currently listed and would change the 'cheapest entry' answer.
suggestions.impact: May produce the first genuinely cheap, confirmed single-entry option.
suggestions.effort: One official page per room (4–6 h).

suggestions.title: Replace the duration heuristic with observed finishes
suggestions.detail: Collect actual finish times for equivalent events from a prior series and use them to score same-day pairs. Removes the one estimate currently used in scheduling.
suggestions.impact: Turns 'conditional fallback' into a real plan.
suggestions.effort: Results pages + a small model change (2 h).

suggestions.title: Add a per-event detail modal with the full structure excerpt
suggestions.detail: Each row already links its structure sheet; a modal would show the verbatim fee, blind-level and late-reg text without leaving the page. Improves manual review, which the brief asked for.
suggestions.impact: Faster human verification of any row.

suggestions.title: Scheduled re-check workflow that flags changed rows
suggestions.detail: A GitHub Action runs on a cron, fetches each official URL, hashes the relevant text, and opens an issue when a hash changes. It cannot re-verify a value automatically — a human still reads the diff — but it catches silent edits.
suggestions.impact: Prevents stale values from looking current.
suggestions.effort: A workflow file + a hash store (1–2 h).

suggestions.title: Live data feed / scraper for tournament schedules
suggestions.detail: Would parse the Venetian calendar and Wynn PDFs automatically. Risky: both are human-formatted, neither has an API, and a silent failure would manufacture false confidence.
suggestions.impact: Freshness, if it works; a new failure mode, if it does not.

suggestions.title: Decide which of the six parallel sites is canonical
suggestions.detail: The repo currently publishes six overlapping snapshots. Either retire the older ones, or keep them explicitly as dated history with a banner. Mixed claims across sites is the main repo-level risk.
suggestions.impact: Removes the chance of contradictory advice on the same domain.
suggestions.effort: A decision, then link/redirect work (1 h).

suggestions.title: Trip-cost optimiser across venues
suggestions.detail: A solver that picks the cheapest combination of events + hotel + parking under a walking constraint. It would be impressive and, today, precisely wrong — the inputs include several unverified fees and an unresolved entry rule.
suggestions.effort: High, and wasted if the inputs change.

suggestions.title: Map view with drawn walking routes
suggestions.detail: Plot each hotel and poker room and draw the OSRM route. Nice for confidence, but the distances are all under 6 minutes and the real friction is indoors, which a map cannot show.
suggestions.impact: Cosmetic; does not change a decision.

suggestions.title: Email alerts for new series announcements
suggestions.detail: Venetian publishes future DeepStack series ~3 months out. An alert would help planning a longer trip, but only after date-specific rates exist.
suggestions.effort: Low, but needs a mail provider.
